node.statement: F2 WEIL-NEWTON ARC BOUND (2026-07-09, campaign L2b'; note background/nodes/u2c_giant_tnull_dichotomy/notes/F2_L2B_WEIL_NEWTON_ARC_BOUND.md, verifier f2_l2b_weil_newton_modal.py, digest F2_L2B_WEIL_NEWTON_PASS): uniform minor-arc estimate for the t-null moment map. Lemma A (subgroup Weil): |sum_{x in mu_n} psi(f_lambda(x))| <= 2 sqrt(q) for every arc lambda != 0 (annihilator decomposition + twisted Weil; degree t gives t*sqrt(q) verbatim). DILATION IDENTITY: power sums of an arc's phase system are first moments of DILATED arcs (psi(v)^r = psi(rv)), so every p_r is Lemma-A-bounded. Lemma B (Newton majorization): |p_r| <= M for r <= b forces |e_b| <= [z^b](1-z)^{-M} = M(M+1)...(M+b-1)/b!. COROLLARY: |E_b(lambda)| <= W(q,b) = prod_{r<b}(2 sqrt q + r)/b! for EVERY nontrivial arc — verified exhaustively (max observed ratio 0.06, headroom 16-160x); hence N(0) <= C(n,b)/q^2 + W(q,b) at every row, every b, and the same at n-b by the PROVED complementation lemma. REACH (exact big-int, budget n^3): b* = 5 at the PRINTED shapes q = m*n+1, m in {3,8,64}, n = 2^13..2^41 — the extreme bands are paid AT THOSE SHAPES. CATCH #4 QUARANTINE (2026-07-09 late): whether these are F2's official-row shapes is OPEN — the official sub-balance rows have q^t >= 2^n with LARGE t (catch-#11 scale: n = 2^21, q ~ 2^31, t ~ 10^4), not the t = 2 small-m toy shape; the official-row instantiation of the reach table awaits the actual (q, n, t) row table. The lemmas themselves are shape-generic and stand.
